issue_title: [Bug] next_id() 在并发场景下可能产生重复 ID (race condition)

verification.ruff_command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/cli.py

approach: Added file locking using fcntl.flock to protect the load-compute-save sequence in TodoApp.add(). A new _lock() context manager in TodoStorage acquires an exclusive lock on a separate .lock file before the add operation, ensuring atomicity across concurrent processes.
risks: File locking is Unix-only (fcntl is POSIX). This fix will not work on Windows.
Lock files (.json.lock) are left behind after operations - this is harmless but may accumulate.
If a process crashes while holding the lock, other processes may be blocked until the lock is released by the OS.
